message.content:
Based on the provided mockup, here is the exhaustive, pixel-perfect visual specification for the GREYWING homepage.

### 1. Overall Layout & Grid
*   **Container:** The content is centered within a max-width container (approx. 1280px–1400px) with consistent horizontal padding (approx. 40px–60px on desktop).
*   **Grid System:** The layout uses a flexible 12-column grid.
    *   **Hero Section:** Split roughly 45% text (left) / 55% image (right).
    *   **Entry Doors (Cards):** A 3-column equal-width grid with a gap of approx. 24px.
    *   **How it Works:** A 4-column layout (1 for title/intro, 3 for steps).
*   **Background:** The main page background is an off-white/cream (`#FDFBF7` or similar). The Hero section has a full-bleed photographic background.

### 2. Header / Navigation Structure
*   **Top Bar (Utility Nav):**
    *   **Background:** Dark charcoal/slate (`#2C3E50` or `#34495E`).
    *   **Height:** Approx. 36px–40px.
    *   **Left Content:** Three text links separated by vertical pipes (`|`): "Healthy Birds", "Ethical Breeding", "Worldwide Support". Font is small, white, sans-serif, uppercase or small-caps.
    *   **Right Content:**
        *   Headphone icon + "Avian Advice: $15/hour".
        *   User icon + "Sign In".
        *   US Flag icon + "USD" + dropdown chevron.
*   **Main Header:**
    *   **Background:** Pure White (`#FFFFFF`).
    *   **Height:** Approx. 80px–90px.
    *   **Logo (Left):** Stylized bird icon (grey body, red/orange wing sweep). Text: "**GREY**" (Black/Dark Grey, Bold Sans-Serif) + "**WING**" (Red `#B83B3B`, Bold Sans-Serif). Sub-text below logo: "BIRDS • SUPPLIES • EXPERT CARE" in tiny tracking-wide caps.
    *   **Navigation (Center-Left):** Dropdown menus for "Parrots", "Cages & Supplies", "Avian Advice". Static links: "Our Promise", "Contact". Font is clean sans-serif, dark grey, medium weight.
    *   **Search (Right-Center):** Rounded rectangle input field. Placeholder: "Search parrots, cages, supplies...". Magnifying glass icon inside left.
    *   **Actions (Far Right):**
        *   Shopping Cart Icon with a red notification badge containing the number "0".
        *   **Primary CTA Button:** "My Requests". Background: Deep Red (`#A93226`). Text: White. Rounded corners (pill shape). Document/List icon to the left of text.

### 3. Hero Section
*   **Background Image:** High-quality, full-bleed photograph of an African Grey Parrot perched on a branch, surrounded by lush green foliage (bokeh effect). Dark overlay gradient on the left side to ensure text readability.
*   **Text Container (Left-Aligned):**
    *   **Eyebrow Text:** "PREMIUM PARROTS • QUALITY SUPPLIES • EXPERT GUIDANCE". Color: Off-white/Light Grey. Font: Sans-serif, uppercase, letter-spaced (tracking: 0.15em), size approx. 12px–13px.
    *   **Main Headline:** "**A brighter life**" (White, Serif font, very large ~60px–72px) + "**with birds**" ("with" is white, "birds" is a warm Gold/Mustard color `#D4AC0D` or `#F1C40F`, same Serif font).
    *   **Sub-headline:** "Ethically raised parrot, essentials & avian care for happy, healthy companions." Color: White/Light Grey. Font: Sans-serif, approx. 18px–20px, line-height 1.5.
    *   **CTAs (Horizontal Row):**
        1.  **Primary:** "Explore parrots →". Background: Red (`#C0392B`). Text: White. Pill-shaped. Arrow icon.
        2.  **Secondary:** "Book avian advice". Background: Transparent. Border: 1px solid White/Light Grey. Text: White. Calendar icon. Pill-shaped.
    *   **Trust Indicators (Below CTAs):** Three items in a row.
        *   Leaf icon + "Ethical & Responsible Breeding"
        *   Heart icon + "Healthy, Socialized Parrots"
        *   Globe icon + "Support for Bird Lovers Worldwide"
        *   *Style:* Icons are outlined/stroke style. Text is small, white/grey.

### 4. The Three Entry Doors (Feature Cards)
*   **Layout:** 3 Cards, equal width, rounded corners (approx. 12px–16px), subtle shadow.
*   **Card 1: Parrots**
    *   **Image:** Photo of African Grey, Blue & Gold Macaw, and Cockatoo together on a branch.
    *   **Title:** "Parrots" (Large, Black, Serif).
    *   **Description:** "African Grey, Macaws, Cockatoos and more." (Dark Grey, Sans-serif).
    *   **CTA:** "View parrots →" (Red background, white text, pill shape).
*   **Card 2: Cages & Supplies**
    *   **Image:** Large, ornate black birdcage with colorful toys, next to a potted plant.
    *   **Title:** "Cages & Supplies" (Serif).
    *   **Description:** "Cages, perches, toys, food and everyday essentials."
    *   **CTA:** "Shop supplies →" (Dark Green/Teal background `#1E8449`, white text, pill shape).
*   **Card 3: Avian Advice**
    *   **Image:** Female veterinarian/avian expert in a white coat holding/examining an African Grey. Warm, clinical but friendly lighting.
    *   **Title:** "Avian Advice" (Serif).
    *   **Price:** "$15 / hour" (Large, bold, black).
    *   **Description:** "Get expert advice from qualified avian professionals."
    *   **CTA:** "Book a consultation →" (Mustard/Gold background `#D4AC0D`, dark text, pill shape).

### 5. 'How It Works' Section
*   **Background:** Same off-white as page body (`#FDFBF7`).
*   **Section Title (Left):** "**How it works**" (Very large, Black, Serif font). Subtext below: "A simple and secure way to get the birds, supplies or advice you need." (Grey, Sans-serif).
*   **Steps (Right, Horizontal Flow):**
    *   **Step 1:** Number "1" in a Red circle. Cart icon. Heading: "**Choose**". Text: "Browse parrots, supplies or book an avian advice session. Fill in the request-form." Right arrow `>` separator.
    *   **Step 2:** Number "2" in a Dark Green circle. Envelope icon. Heading: "**Send request**". Text: "You'll receive a confirmation email from us with your request details and next steps." Right arrow `>` separator.
    *   **Step 3:** Number "3" in a Mustard/Gold circle. Group of people icon. Heading: "**Confirm with our team**". Text: "Our agent will contact you by email with the available payment options and instructions. Once your payment is confirmed, we'll process your order or booking."

### 6. Trust Badges, Footer & Contact Info
*(Note: The footer is cut off in this viewport, but visible elements include)*
*   **Trust Signals:** Integrated into the Hero (breeding/socialized/support icons) and implied through the "Our Promise" nav link and professional imagery (vet in Card 3).
*   **Footer (Partially Visible):** Likely contains standard links (Shipping, Returns, Privacy) based on the "Contact" and "Our Promise" nav items.

### 7. Color Palette (Exact Visual Estimates)
*   **Primary Red (Brand/CTAs):** `#B03A2E` to `#C0392B` (Warm brick red).
*   **Secondary Green (Supplies):** `#196F3D` to `#1E8449` (Forest/Emerald green).
*   **Accent Gold (Advice/Birds word):** `#D4AC0D` to `#F1C40F` (Muted mustard/yellow).
*   **Background Cream:** `#FCFBF8` or `#F9F7F2`.
*   **Dark Text:** `#1C1C1C` (Near black).
*   **Body Text:** `#555555` or `#666666` (Medium grey).
*   **Top Nav Background:** `#2C3E50` (Blue-grey slate).

### 8. Typography Specification
*   **Headings (H1, H2, Card Titles):** **Serif Font Family** (Resembles *Playfair Display*, *Libre Baskerville*, or *Merriweather*). Elegant, high contrast between thick/thin strokes. Used for "A brighter life", "Parrots", "How it works".
*   **Body Text, Nav, Buttons:** **Sans-Serif Font Family** (Resembles *Inter*, *Roboto*, or *Open Sans*). Clean, geometric, highly readable.
*   **Hierarchy:**
    *   H1: ~64px–72px (Hero)
    *   H2: ~36px–42px (Section Headers/Card Titles)
    *   Body: ~16px–18px
    *   Small/Caption: ~13px–14px (Nav, Eyebrow text)

### 9. Bird Imagery & Photo Treatment
*   **Hero Bird:** African Grey Parrot. Sharp focus on head/eye, soft focus background (bokeh). Natural lighting highlighting feather texture (scalloping). Positioned looking slightly left toward the text.
*   **Card 1 Birds:** Trio shot (Grey, Macaw, Cockatoo). Vibrant colors contrasting with the neutral card bg.
*   **Card 3 Human/Bird Interaction:** Candid, warm-toned photo. Focus on the bond between human and bird. Professional but approachable.

### 10. Microcopy (Verbatim Text Strings)
*   "Healthy Birds | Ethical Breeding | Worldwide Support"
*   "GREY WING - BIRDS • SUPPLIES • EXPERT CARE"
*   "Avian Advice: $15/hour"
*   "Search parrots, cages, supplies..."
*   "My Requests"
*   "PREMIUM PARROTS • QUALITY SUPPLIES • EXPERT GUIDANCE"
*   "A brighter life **with birds**"
*   "Ethically raised parrots, essentials & avian care for happy, healthy companions."
*   "Explore parrots →"
*   "Book avian advice"
*   "Ethical & Responsible Breeding"
*   "Healthy, Socialized Parrots"
*   "Support for Bird Lovers Worldwide"
*   "Parrots - African Grey, Macaws, Cockatoos and more."
*   "Cages & Supplies - Cages, perches, toys, food and everyday essentials."
*   "Avian Advice $15 / hour - Get expert advice from qualified avian professionals."
*   "How it works - A simple and secure way to get the birds, supplies or advice you need."
*   "Choose - Browse parrots, supplies or book an avian advice session. Fill in the request-form."
*   "Send request - You'll receive a confirmation email from us with your request details and next steps."
*   "Confirm with our team - Our agent will contact you by email with the available payment options and instructions..."

### 11. Overall Mood & Style
*   **Style:** **Editorial Premium / Warm Luxury**. It avoids the typical "cluttered pet store" look.
*   **Mood:** Trustworthy, sophisticated, compassionate, and nature-connected. The use of serif fonts and cream backgrounds evokes high-end print magazines or luxury lifestyle brands. The photography emphasizes the beauty and intelligence of the birds rather than just selling products.
